title: Earnings Calendar Next 72 Hours
description: Fetches the Nasdaq earnings calendar for the next four days and filters to earnings reports at least 8 hours away but not more than 72 hours out. Each row carries ticker, company, report_datetime_bmo_amc_code, analyst EPS estimate, prior-year EPS, revenue estimate, market-cap tier (MEGA/LARGE/MID/SMALL heuristic from a mega-cap allowlist), and hours_until_earnings. Feeds alert groups that want equity catalyst coverage with a ≥8 hour decision runway. If Nasdaq blocks or returns empty, a single ERROR row is emitted so downstream searches do not silently miss a cycle.
